Policies and Initiatives.title: Digi push: Govt allocates Rs 225cr for UP AI Mission
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Indian government has allocated Rs 225 crore for the UP AI Mission, a significant investment in the state's digital push. This allocation aims to promote artificial intelligence in Uttar Pradesh, driving technological advancements and innovation. The funding is expected to support various AI-related initiatives and projects in the region.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Govt signs MoU with ARF for AI-driven urban governance
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Odisha's housing department has partnered with IIT Kanpur's AIRAWAT Research Foundation to enhance urban governance through artificial intelligence. The collaboration aims to leverage AI for better urban planning and service delivery, and an AI Project Management Unit will be established. This initiative will create a multi-year AI roadmap for Odisha's urban development goals.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Uttar Pradesh Budget 2026-27: From ‘AI Mission’ to ‘U-Hub’, how govt plans to boost jobs for youth
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Uttar Pradesh government has announced plans to launch an "AI Mission" and "U-Hub" initiative in its 2026-27 budget to boost job creation for youth. The initiatives aim to promote artificial intelligence and entrepreneurship, respectively, to generate employment opportunities. The government hopes to leverage these programs to drive economic growth and development in the state.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Policy Leaders and Innovators deliberate future of Responsible Health AI as Federated Intelligence Hackathon Concludes at IIT Kanpur
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Policy leaders and innovators gathered at IIT Kanpur to discuss the future of responsible health AI. The event coincided with the conclusion of the Federated Intelligence Hackathon, which focused on health AI. The deliberations aimed to shape the development of health AI in a responsible and innovative manner.

Policies and Initiatives.title: UP govt to host AI-led innovation, skills conference in Lucknow
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Uttar Pradesh government will host an AI-led innovation and skills conference in Lucknow, bringing together global technology majors. Companies such as Microsoft, Google, TCS, and Intel are set to participate in the event. The conference aims to promote AI-led innovation and skills development in the region.

Major AI Developments.title: Rs 2 lakh crore AI hub to come up off Yamuna Expressway in 2 years
Major AI Developments.summary: A new AI hub worth Rs 2 lakh crore is set to be established off the Yamuna Expressway. The project is expected to be completed within two years, with the hub aiming to become a major center for artificial intelligence. The hub's development is anticipated to drive significant growth and innovation in the region.

Major AI Developments.title: UP inks MoU for 1GW AI hub in YEIDA; operations to start by 2028
Major AI Developments.summary: The Uttar Pradesh government has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to establish a 1GW AI hub in the Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority (YEIDA) area. The project aims to start operations by 2028, with the hub expected to drive growth and innovation in the region. The initiative is part of the state's efforts to promote artificial intelligence and technology development.

Major AI Developments.title: AM group, Invest UP sign MoU to set up $25 billion AI data centre in Uttar Pradesh
Major AI Developments.summary: The AM group and Invest UP have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to establish a $25 billion AI data centre in Uttar Pradesh. The Yeida authority has allotted 289 acres of land for the project, which will be a 1 GW carbon-free facility. The data centre aims to reach full operational capacity by 2030.
